newsitem.title: CHINA: China natural rubber imports up 3.4 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: China natural rubber imports up 3.4 pct in June.

text.p: China's imports of natural rubber reached 30,000 tonnes in June, up 3.4 percent compared with the same month last year, China Securities said on Tuesday.
The newspaper did not say whether the imports included latex.
China imported 190,000 tonnes of natural rubber, including latex, in the first five months, up 6.1 percent from the year-ago period, according to previously released customs figures.
China's imports of synthetic rubber reached 32,000 tonnes in June, a rise of 28 percent compared with the same month last year, the newspaper said.
China's imports of synthetic rubber, including latex, in the first five months were 164,064 tonnes, up by 15.5 percent year-on-year, customs figures showed.
